title: Cursor MCP tool calls complete on every model
highlights: Cursor MCP tool calls now complete on Composer, Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6, and Claude models instead of hanging after the tool is requested
fixes: Switching a session to Cursor with /model no longer leaves MCP tool calls stuck: tool results are sent back to Cursor
jcode answers Cursor's MCP server state and tool allowlist checks, so the model's tool call actually reaches jcode
Cursor model names resolve against Cursor's live model list, so Grok 4.6, Claude Opus 5/5.5, and GPT-5.6 Sol no longer fail with 'Model name is not valid'
